h1. Dynatrace SILVA PagerDuty Operations Umbrella

{info:title=Audience}
SRE / on-call and platform engineers who need the *full picture*: when Dynatrace starts detecting problems, which apps own which step, how S0 OPEN and S2 CLOSE workflows run, and where the related instructions / runbooks live.
{info}

{warning:title=Safety}
OPEN and CLOSE workflows *send* to SILVA and PagerDuty when Deployed. Keep Draft or {{DRY_RUN}} until tested. Never put passwords or routing keys in Confluence. Only *one* OPEN and *one* CLOSE workflow should own a given problem scope. Drafts are not triggered.
{warning}

----

h2. Decision tree

{code}
Something wrong in monitored apps/hosts?
  → Davis detects a Problem (Dynatrace Problems app)
  → Problem becomes ACTIVE + CREATED?
       → S0 OPEN workflow (Automations) → SILVA ticket + PagerDuty page
  → Problem becomes CLOSED?
       → S2 CLOSE workflow (Automations) → SILVA Resolved + PD resolve
 Need AI catch-up in Slack/Teams without PD Advance?
  → Optional WF-A / Dynatrace AI Assistant runbooks
 Chat AI in PagerDuty Slack/Teams?
  → PagerDuty AI instructions (separate from S0/S2)
 Stuck?
  → Open the matching runbook below (preview fail, close_code, Not Connected, …)
{code}

----

h2. Short takeaway

||Question||Answer||
|When does detection start?|When Dynatrace *Davis* opens a Problem on monitored entities (apps, services, hosts, …)|
|When does S0 OPEN start?|Problem *Active* + status transition *CREATED* (and category filters match)|
|When does S2 CLOSE start?|Problem *Closed* (same category family as configured)|
|Which Dynatrace app runs the graphs?|*Workflows / Automations* ({{dynatrace.automations}})|
|Which external apps?|*SILVA* (ServiceNow ITSM) + *PagerDuty* (paging)|
|Where are deep runbooks?|Child Confluence pages + CursorFiles Daily Files listed below|

----

h2. Summary

Problem *detection* happens in Dynatrace (Davis / Problems). Problem *ticketing and paging* happen in Automations workflows that call SILVA and PagerDuty. This umbrella page explains *when* each stage starts, *which app* owns it, and points to the staff instructions for OPEN, CLOSE, AI notify, and PagerDuty chat AI.

----

h2. Words you need first

||Word||What it means||Why you care||
|Davis / Problem|Dynatrace’s detected issue object|Detection starts here — before any workflow|
|Automations / Workflows|Dynatrace app that runs S0 / S2 graphs|Where OPEN/CLOSE logic lives|
|SILVA|ServiceNow ITSM instance|Incident ticket system|
|PagerDuty|On-call paging product|Who gets woken|
|S0 OPEN|Preview then POST workflow|Creates ticket + page on problem open|
|S2 CLOSE|Direct close workflow|Resolves ticket + PD when problem closes|
|Alerting profile / tags|Who/what is eligible to alert|Can narrow which problems reach workflows|
|correlation_id / dedup_key|Shared ids across OPEN and CLOSE|{{P-…}} and {{dt-problem-P-…}}|

----

h2. When does problem detection start?

h3. Detection (before workflows)

Dynatrace continuously monitors entities (services, processes, hosts, synthetic, custom events, …). *Davis* opens a *Problem* when it decides something is wrong (error rate, availability, resource, slowdown, custom, …).

||Stage||What happens||Where you see it||
|Monitor|OneAgent / extensions / logs / metrics ingest|Dynatrace entity pages|
|Detect|Davis correlates signals → *Problem*|Problems app / Problems list|
|Notify (optional)|Alerting profile / notification channels|Email, Slack via DT, webhooks, …|
|Automate|Workflows trigger on Problem Active or Closed|Automations → Workflows|

*Important:* Opening a Problem is *not* the same as creating a SILVA ticket. The ticket only appears after *S0 OPEN* runs successfully (and is Deployed, not Draft).

h3. What “related to which app” means in practice

Problems are usually tied to *affected entities* (for example a Kubernetes service, a process group, a host named like {{BILoss-…}}, or a custom device). Tags on those entities (business service, assignment group, environment, app code) are what {{extract-event-tags}} / {{resolve-snow-values}} use to fill SILVA fields.

||If the problem is about…||Typical Dynatrace entity / signal||What S0 needs from it||
|A named host / VM|{{host}} / {{host.name}}|Host CI lookup, environment tags|
|A K8s workload|pod / namespace / service|App identity via tags / names|
|A service / PG|service, process group|Service tags → business service|
|Custom / availability|synthetic or custom event|Category custom / availability|

If tags are missing, S0 preview will report MISSING fields and *skip* create (by design).

----

h2. When do the workflows start?

h3. S0 OPEN — start conditions

||Setting||Typical value||Meaning||
|Event|Davis problem|Only problems, not raw logs|
|Status|ACTIVE|Problem is open|
|Transition|CREATED|Fire on *new* open (not every update)|
|Categories|error, resource, slowdown, availability, custom|Matches screenshot / standard v7.1|
|onProblemClose|false|OPEN does not run on close|
|Workflow status|Deployed (not Draft)|Drafts are not triggered|

h3. S2 CLOSE — start conditions

||Setting||Typical value||Meaning||
|Event|Davis problem|Same problem family|
|Event state|closed|Problem recovered / closed|
|Categories|Same family as OPEN|Keep OPEN/CLOSE aligned|
|Workflow status|Deployed|Drafts are not triggered|

h3. Timeline (happy path)

{code}
T0   Davis opens Problem P-…
T0+  S0 OPEN runs (if Deployed + filters match)
       → SILVA incident created (correlation_id = P-…)
       → PagerDuty trigger (dedup_key = dt-problem-P-…)
T1   Humans investigate / fix
T2   Davis closes Problem P-…
T2+  S2 CLOSE runs
       → SILVA PATCH Resolved (find by correlation_id)
       → PagerDuty resolve (same dedup_key)
{code}

h2. Related apps (who owns what)

||App / product||Role in this design||What you configure there||
|*Dynatrace — Problems / Davis*|Detects and closes problems|Monitoring, anomaly detection, problem feed|
|*Dynatrace — Automations (Workflows)*|Runs S0 OPEN + S2 CLOSE|Workflow Deploy, allowlists, secrets, DRY_RUN|
|*Dynatrace — Hub Connections*|Credentials for HTTP if used|Prefer secrets in workflow / Connection store|
|*SILVA (ServiceNow)*|ITSM incident of record|Assignment groups, close codes, CMDB services/CIs|
|*PagerDuty*|On-call page / resolve|Service, escalation policy, Events API routing key|
|*PagerDuty Slack / Teams apps* (optional)|PD AI chat (Paige / Scribe)|Advance license + Connected chat — *not* required for S0/S2|
|*Dynatrace Slack / Teams connectors* (optional)|WF-A AI catch-up messages|Separate from SILVA/PD OPEN|

h2. Data flow map (full stack)

{code}
Monitored app / host / service
  → Dynatrace ingest (OneAgent / extensions / logs / metrics)
  → Davis Problem (Problems app)     ←── "detection starts" here
  → Automations Workflows app
        ├─ S0 OPEN (Active CREATED)
        │     → SILVA POST incident
        │     → PagerDuty trigger
        └─ S2 CLOSE (Closed)
              → SILVA PATCH Resolved
              → PagerDuty resolve
  → Optional: Dynatrace AI → Slack/Teams (WF-A)
  → Optional: PagerDuty AI in Slack/Teams (Advance)
{code}
